svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from a 1.0 x 1.25 m sheet. The body is 996 x 996 mm; the low

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge is a zigzag (see the low edge picture): tips at the six

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: distillate tongues, roots 25 mm shorter at the strip centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six distillate tongues 30 mm wide, 56.5 mm long from the tip line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (drawn straight here). They stay straight until the manifold is on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lip: four tabs 7 mm wide on the high edge, centred on the rib lines

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (97.2 and 291.6 mm each side of the centre line), 5 mm of metal

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each; bend each 90 deg down to hang 4 mm below the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with aviation snips; file the edges smooth; no burrs on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Coat the top face (condensing face) with the fluoropolymer coating,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tongues included, after the lip is bent and before the fins go on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fins: ten, bonded under it at 99.6 mm pitch with high-temperature

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: silicone adhesive along each 20 mm flange (sketch SSK-DWG-108).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Later: bend each tongue down 90 deg 47 mm from the tip line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: its edges rest on the base ring's 13 mm ledge; the four lip

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tabs go down into the slots in the ring's high strip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat within 2 mm on the bench; coating unbroken.
